title: Hearing on Mayor Mamdani's housing production plan
summary: The City Council's Land Use Committee will hold an oversight hearing on October 21, 2026 examining the planning and development chapters of Mayor Mamdani's "Block by Block" housing plan, which aims to build 200,000 new affordable homes over ten years. The hearing will focus on strategies such as a new fast-track zoning process for 12 low-production community districts, a citywide Fair Housing Growth Strategy setting a five-year target of 350,000 new units, and expanded transit-oriented development zoning. City Planning and Housing Preservation and Development officials along with housing advocates are expected to testify.
